question: Does the production-path harness with only the LINE SDK profile call stubbed justify a proof override, or must this PR demonstrate the cache under a live LINE gateway?
rationale: The patch changes an internal Map invariant that the harness exercises directly, so live LINE traffic may add little technical signal, but repository policy requires real-setup proof for external PRs unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the production-path eviction and retention output because the external SDK response is not part of the changed invariant.

options.title: Require live LINE evidence
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted gateway run or diagnostic demonstrates bounded behavior with real LINE profile responses.

recommendation.title: Grant proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the production-path eviction and retention output because the external SDK response is not part of the changed invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent-history owner for the affected LINE send path and can judge whether live provider proof adds material confidence.
